items.name: Shortsword
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

items.name: Pistol
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 30/90 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Piercing damage.

items.name: Hustle
items.notes: The smuggler can move through the space of any creature that is of a larger size, but it can't stop there.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The underboss makes three attacks, using Poisoned Blade or Arcane Firearm in any combination.

items.name: Poisoned Blade
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the underboss's next turn. If the target is already Poisoned, it instead takes an extra 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

items.name: Arcane Firearm
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 30/90 ft. Hit: 26 (4d10 + 4) Force damage.

items.name: Uncanny Dodge
items.notes: The underboss is hit by an attack roll. The underboss halves the damage (round down) it takes from that attack.

items.name: Hustle
items.notes: The underboss can move through the space of any creature that is of a larger size, but it can't stop there.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The artificer casts one of the following spells, using its Tinker's Tools as an Arcane Focus and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (DC 14):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The artificer makes two attacks, using Battering Mace or Artillery Strike in any combination.

items.name: Battering Mace
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

items.name: Artillery Strike
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) Force damage.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The bruiser makes three Pummel attacks and uses Glare.

items.name: Pummel
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Glare
items.notes: Wisdom saving throw DC 14, one creature the bruiser can see within 30 feet. On a failed save, The target has the Frightened condition until the start of the bruiser's next turn.

items.name: Smackback
items.notes: The bruiser takes damage from a creature within 5 feet. The bruiser makes one Pummel attack, targeting the triggering creature.

items.name: Blood Frenzy
items.notes: The bruiser has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its Hit Points.

items.name: Pummel
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Smackback
items.notes: The raider takes damage from a creature within 5 feet. The raider makes one Pummel attack, targeting the triggering creature.

items.name: Pack Tactics
items.notes: The raider has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the raider's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The infiltrator casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The infiltrator makes three Mind Blade attacks.

items.name: Mind Blade
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Psychic damage.

items.name: Mind Curse
items.notes: Wisdom saving throw DC 15, one creature hit by the infiltrator's Mind Blade attack this turn. On a failed save, The target takes 14 (4d6) Psychic damage and is cursed. While cursed in this way, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls against the infiltrator, and the infiltrator always knows its location while it and the infiltrator are on the same plane of existence. A cursed creature repeats the save whenever it finishes a Short or Long Rest, ending the effect on itself on a success. On a successful save, Half damage only.

spellcasting.name: Slayer's Puppet (1/Day)
spellcasting.notes: The mindkiller casts Dominate Person, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17).

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The mindkiller makes two Nightmare Whisper attacks.

items.name: Nightmare Whisper
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. Hit: 27 (5d8 + 5) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the mindkiller's next turn. If the target is already Frightened, it instead takes an extra 10 (3d6) Psychic damage.

items.name: Primal Fear
items.notes: Wisdom saving throw DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the mindkiller can see within 120 feet. On a failed save, 35 (10d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the mindkiller's next turn. While Frightened in this way, the target can do only one of the following on each of its turns: move, take an action, or take a Bonus Action. On a successful save Half damage only.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The commander makes two attacks, using Flail or Javelin in any combination.

items.name: Flail
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage—plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage if the commander is Bloodied—and the target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of the commander's next turn.

items.name: Javelin
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage—plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage if the commander is Bloodied.

items.name: Aura of Authority
items.notes: While in a 30-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the commander, the commander and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the commander doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The knight makes two attacks, using Flail or Javelin in any combination.

items.name: Flail
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage—plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage if the knight is Bloodied—and the target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of the knight's next turn.

items.name: Javelin
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage—plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage if the knight is Bloodied.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The troubleshooter casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The troubleshooter makes two Poisoned Dagger attacks.

items.name: Poisoned Dagger
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the troubleshooter's next turn.

items.name: Nimble Escape
items.notes: The troubleshooter takes the Disengage or Hide action.

items.name: Hustle
items.notes: The troubleshooter can move through the space of any creature that is of a larger size, but it can't stop there.

hp.special: 5 + 5 per spell level (the homunculus has a number of Hit Dice [d4s] equal to the spell's level)

items.name: Force Strike
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: YourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. Hit: 1d6 + summonSpellLevel Force damage.

items.name: Channel Magic
items.notes: You cast a spell that has a range of touch while the homunculus is within 120 feet of you. The homunculus delivers the spell through its touch.

items.name: Evasion
items.notes: If the homunculus is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the homunculus instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it has the Incapacitated condition.

items.name: Magic Bond
items.notes: Add the spell's level to any ability check or saving throw the homunculus makes.

spellcasting.name: Mark of Healing (2/Day)
spellcasting.notes: The medic casts Cure Wounds or Lesser Restoration, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The medic makes two Radiant Burst attacks.

items.name: Radiant Burst
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Radiant damage, and the creature has the Blinded condition until the start of the medic's next turn.

items.name: Lucky
items.notes: When the medic rolls a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, it can reroll the die, and it must use the new roll.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The warden casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (DC 14):

spellcasting.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
spellcasting.notes: The warden casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The warden makes two Arcane Whip attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Shackling Glyph if available.

items.name: Arcane Whip
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Force damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. If the target already has the Prone condition, the attack deals an extra 7 (2d6) Force damage.

items.name: Shackling Glyph
items.notes: Strength saving throw DC 14, one creature the warden can see within 60 feet. On a failed save, the creature has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14). While Grappled, the creature has the Restrained condition.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The warden has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The scion casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

spellcasting.name: Jump (2/Day)
spellcasting.notes: The scion casts Jump, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

spellcasting.name: Feather Fall (2/Day)
spellcasting.notes: The scion casts Feather Fall in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The scion makes two Thunderbolt attacks and uses Spellcasting.

items.name: Thunderbolt
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Lightning damage plus 9 (2d8) Thunder damage. Critical Hit: The creature also has the Deafened condition for 1 minute.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The inquisitive casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (DC 13): At Will : Guidance

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The inquisitive makes three Crooked Staff attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Inquisitive Eye.

items.name: Crooked Staff
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. If the target already has the Prone condition, the attack deals an extra 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.

items.name: Inquisitive Eye
items.notes: Wisdom saving throw DC 13, one creature the inquisitive can see within 60 feet. On a failed save, 10 (3d6) Psychic damage, and the target is marked. The inquisitive has Advantage on attack rolls against a target it has marked. While marked, the target can't become hidden from the inquisitive, and if it has the Invisible condition, it gains no benefit from that condition against the inquisitive. The mark disappears after 1 minute or when the inquisitive uses this action again. On a successful save, half damage only.

items.name: Spontaneous Barrier
items.notes: The inquisitive or an ally it can see is hit with an attack roll. The inquisitive adds 2 to its or the ally's AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

spellcasting.name: Misty Step (2/Day)
spellcasting.notes: The enforcer casts Misty Step, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The enforcer makes three Dagger attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Lightning Cage if available.

items.name: Dagger
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

items.name: Lightning Cage
items.notes: Constitution saving throw DC 13, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the enforcer can see within 60 feet. On a failed save, 13 (3d8) Lightning damage, and the creature can't take Reactions until the end of the enforcer's next turn. On a successful save, Half damage only.

items.name: Temporal Disruption
items.notes: The enforcer takes damage from a melee attack. The enforcer teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Each creature within 10 feet of the space the enforcer left must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, or its Speed is halved until the start of the enforcer's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Shield (3/Day)
spellcasting.notes: The marshal casts Shield in response to the spell's trigger, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The marshal makes three attacks, using Longsword or Pistol in any combination.

items.name: Longsword
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage, and the target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of the marshal's next turn.

items.name: Pistol
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 30/90 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The agent casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (DC 14):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The agent makes two Shadow Knife attacks.

items.name: Shadow Knife
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage, and the target's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Shadow Cloak
items.notes: The agent has the Invisible condition until the start of its next turn. This invisibility ends early immediately after the agent makes an attack roll.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes:
The scribe casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (DC 13):

1/Day: Sending

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The scribe makes two Bursting Sigil attacks.

items.name: Bursting Sigil
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Radiant damage.

items.name: Word of Stasis
items.notes: Constitution saving throw DC 13, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the scribe can see within 60 feet. On a failed save, The target has the Incapacitated condition until the start of the scribe's next turn. While the target is Incapacitated, its Speed is 0 and can't increase.

items.name: Words of Reason
items.notes: Allies in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the scribe have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened condition. This trait doesn't function if the scribe has the Incapacitated condition.

hp.special: 5 + five times your Artificer level (the defender has a number of Hit Dice [d8s] equal to your Artificer level)

items.name: Force-Empowered Rend
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: Your spell attack bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d8 + 2 plus your Intelligence modifier Force damage.

items.name: Repair
items.notes: The defender, or one Construct or object it can see within 5 feet of itself, regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d8 plus your Intelligence modifier.

items.name: Deflect Attack
items.notes: A creature the defender can see within 5 feet of itself makes an attack roll against a creature other than the defender. The triggering creature makes the attack roll with Disadvantage.

items.name: Steel Bond
items.notes: Add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check or saving throw the defender makes.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The marauder casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The marauder makes three Aberrant Strike attacks.

items.name: Aberrant Strike
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage, plus 21 (6d6) Force damage if the marauder had Advantage on the attack roll.

items.name: Tear Through Space
items.notes: The marauder teleports to a space it can see within 30 feet, appearing in a dazzling flash. Constitution saving throw DC 17, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the marauder when it appears. On a failed save, the target has the Blinded condition until the end of the marauder's next turn.

items.name: Evasion
items.notes: If the marauder is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the marauder instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half as much damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it has the Incapacitated condition.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The ruffian casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks):

items.name: Spear
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

items.name: Aberrant Surge
items.notes: When the ruffian casts Witch Bolt, roll 1d8. On an even number, the ruffian gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the number rolled. On an odd number, one creature of the ruffian's choice within 30 feet of it takes Force damage equal to the number rolled; if no other creatures are in range, it takes the damage.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The hunter makes three attacks, using Shortsword or Longbow in any combination.

items.name: Shortsword
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Longbow
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Mark of Tharashk
items.notes: The hunter magically marks one creature it can see within 150 feet. The mark lasts for 1 hour, until the target dies, or until the hunter uses this Bonus Action again. While the target is marked in this way, the hunter has Advantage on attack rolls against the target, and the target gains no benefit from the Invisible condition against the hunter.

items.name: Uncanny Dodge
items.notes: The hunter is hit by an attack roll. The hunter halves the damage (round down) it takes from that attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The shadow walker casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The shadow walker makes three Gloom Burst attacks and uses Shadow Cowl.

items.name: Gloom Burst
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Psychic damage.

items.name: Shadow Cowl
items.notes: Wisdom saving throw DC 17, one creature the shadow walker can see within 120 feet. On a failed save, 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the shadow walker's next turn.

items.name: Fey Ancestry
items.notes: Magic can't put the shadow walker to sleep.

items.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
items.notes: While in sunlight, the shadow walker has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The heir casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The heir makes four attacks, using Scimitar or Lunar Wisp in any combination.

items.name: Scimitar
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.

items.name: Lunar Wisp
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 60 ft. Hit: 9 (2d8) Radiant damage, and the target emits Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the Invisible condition until the end of the heir's next turn.

items.name: Spur Beast
items.notes: The heir targets a Beast it can see within 30 feet. The target can take a Reaction to move up to half its Speed and make one melee attack.

items.name: Pack Tactics
items.notes: The heir has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the heir's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

items.name: Stingblade
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

items.name: Boomerang
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 30/120 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Fey Ancestry
items.notes: Magic can't put the stingblade to sleep.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks):

items.name: Venom Staff
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the priest's next turn.

items.name: Intensify Poison
items.notes: Each creature with the Poisoned condition within a 30-foot Emanation originating from the priest takes 3 (1d6) Poison damage.

items.name: Fey Ancestry
items.notes: Magic can't put the priest to sleep.
